SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV

--RecordCount - 6718440

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV
WHERE CANCELLED = 1

--Not Cancelled Count - 6561547
-- Cancelled Count - 156893

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV
WHERE DEP_TIME IS NULL AND CANCELLED = 0

--If a flight is not departed, it should be cancelled
--No records with dep time as null and cancellation status as not cancelled

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV
WHERE ARR_TIME IS NULL AND CANCELLED = 0 AND DIVERTED =0

--If a flight is not landed, it should be either cancelled or diverted
-- No records with arr time as null , which is neither cancelled or diverted

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV
WHERE DEP_TIME IS NOT NULL AND ARR_TIME IS NOT NULL AND CANCELLED = 1

--No records with dep time and arr time which is cancelled


SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV
WHERE FL_DATE IS NULL

--No records with flight date as null

select top 10 otd.FL_DATE,otd.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER
from bronze.OnTimeData_CSV otd
left join bronze.Airlines al on al.Code = otd.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER
where al.Code is null

--No records with invalid airline code

select top 10 otd.FL_DATE,otd.OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID
from bronze.OnTimeData_CSV otd
left join bronze.AirlineId al on al.Code = otd.OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID
where al.Code is null

--no records with invalid airport id

select top 10 otd.FL_DATE,otd.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER,otd.ORIGIN
from bronze.OnTimeData_CSV otd
left join bronze.Airport ap on ap.Code = otd.ORIGIN
where ap.Code is null

--no records with invalid airport code at origin

select top 10 otd.FL_DATE,otd.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER,otd.DEST
from bronze.OnTimeData_CSV otd
left join bronze.Airport ap on ap.Code = otd.DEST
where ap.Code is null

--no records with invalid airport code at dest


select top 10 otd.FL_DATE,otd.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER,otd.ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID
from bronze.OnTimeData_CSV otd
left join bronze.AirportId ap on ap.Code = otd.ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID
where ap.Code is null

--no records with invalid airport id at origin

select top 10 otd.FL_DATE,otd.OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER,otd.DEST_AIRPORT_ID
from bronze.OnTimeData_CSV otd
left join bronze.AirportId ap on ap.Code = otd.DEST_AIRPORT_ID
where ap.Code is null

--no records with invalid airport id at dest

select MAX(DEP_DELAY) depdelaymax,
MAX(DEP_DELAY_NEW) depdelaynewmax,
MIN(DEP_DELAY) depdelaymin,
MIN(DEP_DELAY_NEW) depdelaynewmin
from bronze.OnTimeData_CSV otd

--outliers are present with delay minutes over 1000 minutes.


select FL_DATE,OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER,OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM,
ORIGIN,DEST,COUNT(1)
FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV
GROUP BY FL_DATE,OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER,OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM,ORIGIN,DEST
HAVING COUNT(1) >1

--uniqueness of record to be set
